title: Taikang Launches the Yaoyi Large Model 1.0, Completely Reimagining Comprehensive Life-Cycle Medical and Elderly Care Services
excerpt: TAIKANG Insurance Group has officially released the first version of its self-developed specialized large model for elderly care, medical care, and health manag
content_html:
TAIKANG Insurance Group has officially released the first version of its self-developed specialized large model for elderly care, medical care, and health management. Relying on its unique integrated service system for elderly care, medical care, health management, and well-being, as well as its layout in long-term medical disciplines and exclusive data accumulation from long-term cohorts, TAIKANG is exploring a differentiated development path for specialized large models tailored to its own characteristics.

Tai Kang Insurance Group's President Liu Tingjun stated that the release of the large model is not an end, but a brand new beginning. The launch of the elderly care and medical large model is a key measure for TAIKANG's new life insurance strategy to implement the "integrated service system for the entire life cycle of elderly care, medical care, health management, and well-being" in terms of technology.

In specific application scenarios, the model initially focuses on community-based elderly care, capable of automatically generating health profiles for the elderly, conducting intelligent grouping, and customizing personalized care plans. This innovation completely upgrades the traditional passive call model into a proactive risk warning system. According to the information, in future plans, this elderly care and medical large model will further expand to cover 24/7 health monitoring scenarios for home-based elderly care.
